description: Apply the harmon-init Copier template's conventions (DevOps tooling, CI/CD, lint, security, git hooks, Taskfile) to a repo. Use whenever the user wants to "apply harmon-init", "scaffold a new repo with my conventions", "set up a new project", "adopt the template", "bring this repo up to my standards", "standardize this repo", or "audit this repo against my standards / check what's missing". Covers three modes: scaffolding a brand-new/empty repo, retrofitting an existing repo with git history, and auditing a repo for drift from the standards. Trigger it even if the user doesn't say the word "skill".
